codeBlocks.label: API Flask - Vérification OAuth2
HAProxy - Load Balancer & SSL
codeBlocks.code:
frontend https_front
    bind *:12345 ssl crt /home/tp/certs/server/server.pem
    mode http
    stick-table type ip size 200k expire 30m store conn_rate(60s)
    tcp-request connection track-sc1 src
    acl is_health_check src 127.0.0.1 192.168.1.7 192.168.1.8 192.168.1.9
    tcp-request connection reject if { src_conn_rate ge 50 } !is_health_check
    option forwardfor
    default_backend api_servers

backend api_servers
    balance leastconn
    stick-table type ip size 200k expire 30m store conn_rate(60s)
    stick on src
    option httpchk GET /isalive
    server FRMBAPI01 192.168.1.15:12345 check ssl verify required ca-file /home/tp/certs/ca.pem
    server FRMBAPI02 192.168.1.16:12345 check ssl verify required ca-file /home/tp/certs/ca.pem
    server FRMBAPI03 192.168.1.17:12345 check ssl verify required ca-file /home/tp/certs/ca.pem backup

codeBlocks.label: Playbook Ansible - Backup Config et Configuration SNMP
codeBlocks.code:
name: Récupérer et transférer la configuration Cisco
  hosts: all
  gather_facts: False
  connection: network_cli
  vars_files:
    - credentials.yml

  tasks:
      - name: Configurer la communauté SNMP '4P' en lecture/écriture
        ios_config:
          lines:
            - snmp-server community 4P rw

    - name: Récupérer la configuration complète
      ios_command:
        commands:
          - show running-config
      register: running_config

    - name: Créer un fichier avec la configuration
      copy:
        content: "{{ running_config.stdout[0] }}"
        dest: "/tmp/config_{{ inventory_hostname }}.txt"

    - name: Transférer le fichier vers le serveur FTP
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: |
          ftp -n 8.8.1.12 <<EOF
          user devops
          put /tmp/config_{{ item }}.txt
          quit
          EOF
      delegate_to: localhost
      loop: "{{ ansible_play_hosts }}"
      loop_control:
        loop_var: item

codeBlocks.label: Ansible Playbook - Config Backup and SNMP Configuration
codeBlocks.code:
name: Retrieve and transfer Cisco configuration
  hosts: all
  gather_facts: False
  connection: network_cli
  vars_files:
    - credentials.yml

  tasks:
      - name: Configure SNMP community '4P' with read/write access
        ios_config:
          lines:
            - snmp-server community 4P rw

    - name: Retrieve full configuration
      ios_command:
        commands:
          - show running-config
      register: running_config

    - name: Create a file with the configuration
      copy:
        content: "{{ running_config.stdout[0] }}"
        dest: "/tmp/config_{{ inventory_hostname }}.txt"

    - name: Transfer file to FTP server
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: |
          ftp -n 8.8.1.12 <<EOF
          user devops
          put /tmp/config_{{ item }}.txt
          quit
          EOF
      delegate_to: localhost
      loop: "{{ ansible_play_hosts }}"
      loop_control:
        loop_var: item
